u-garfield-18810309: EXECUTIVE MANSION, March 9, 1881. It is hereby ordered that all the unsurveyed portions of township 2 south, range 1 east, San Bernardino meridian, California, excepting any tract or tracts the title to which has passed out of the United States Government, be, and the same are hereby, withdrawn from sale and settlement, and set apart as a reservation for Indian purposes. JAMES A. GARFIELD.
u-garfield-18810528: DEAR SIR:* I am directed by the President to inform you that the several Departments of the Government will be closed on Monday, the 30th instant, to enable the employees to participate in the decoration of the graves of the soldiers who fell during the rebellion. Very respectfully, *Addressed to the heads of the Executive Departments, etc. J. STANLEY BROWN, Private Secretary.
